prompt: We're an OEM customer with one StackOne organisation. How should we use organisations, projects and accounts to keep each of our customers isolated and to keep dev and prod separate?
skill_note: Organisation, project and account structure is platform territory.

fetch.name: fetches-hierarchy-docs
fetch.note: The concepts pages or the multi-tenant accounts guide.

reply.name: mentions-projects
reply.note: Projects are the unit of isolation for environments.

reference: The hierarchy is organisation, then projects, then linked accounts.
Projects are isolated workspaces with their own region, API keys and linked accounts, so environments such as dev and prod belong in separate projects.
Members and security (roles, MFA, SSO) are managed at the organisation level; organisation Admins see every project and Members only the projects they are granted.
Customers are kept apart within a project by the owner identifiers (origin_owner_id) on their linked accounts.
